Setup.Name: TopicAttribute
Setup.Description: Creates attributes based on the mqtt topic.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Create attributes from the mqtt topic."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/+/data"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Sensor.$(TopicPath('[2]')).Temperature"
          Description: "The current processor temperature."
          Instrument: Gauge
          TopicAttributes: "_/location/device.Id/_"
          Value: "PAYLOAD()"
